text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Angolan Air Force said an aircraft had disappeared between Luanda and the diamond town of Cafunfo in Lunda Norte at the weekend, and a search team would be sent to look for the plane.

- A meeting between United Nations special envoy to Angola, Alioune Blondin Beye, the government and UNITA was called off after consultation with official observers of the peace process earlier in the day.
- Justice Minister Paulo Tjipilica officially launched Angola's new identity cards.
